visualCharacteristics: White article cards (image top, title with arrow icon, outlined category tag pill) in a horizontal slider (about 4.3 visible) with prev/next arrows and progress bar; swipe/drag.
contentPattern: 6 blog article cards in a slider: image, title linking to the article, category tag link (Siding Pro Resources / Exterior Design)
usage: Horizontal slider of article cards (image, linked title with arrow, category tag pills).
reuseGuidance: One row per article: image | title (linked heading) and a paragraph of category tag links. The title link makes the whole card clickable; tags stay separately clickable.
structure: One row per article: image | linked title, category tag links
